not_found.name: Unknown
description: Unable to find the requested slayer talent.

sever_alignment.name: Sever Alignment
description: ::ab{title="&L&Sever Alignment (Su)&FN&" icon=lower ability="When making a sneak attack against an opponent with an alignment subtype, a slayer with this talent can forgo her sneak attack damage to scramble the creature's metaphysical nature. If the attack succeeds, the slayer deals weapon damage as normal, and the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half the slayer's level + the slayer's Intelligence modifier) or lose all damage reduction overcome by aligned weapons (such as DR 10/good), lose all ‹umr/regeneration› overcome by aligned sources (such as regeneration 10 &#91&good&#93&)." prereq="‹slayertalent/Aligned sneak attack›"}

slowing_strike.name: Slowing Strike
description: ::ab{title="&L&Slowing Strike (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="An opponent damaged by the slayer's sneak attack has its speed halved for 1d4 rounds. A successful Fortitude saving throw negates this effect (DC = 10 + 1/2 of the slayer's level + the slayer's Intelligence modifier).~~~Against creatures with multiple types of movement, the slayer must choose which movement type to affect. If the slayer affects a creature's flight movement, its maneuverability is reduced by one step; if it's airborne at the time, it falls unless it succeeds at a DC 10 Fly check.~~~If the slayer targets a creature already affected by this ability, its speed and maneuverability are not further reduced; the slayer may either extend the duration of that effect by 1d4 rounds or choose another movement type to affect (keeping track of the duration of each affected movement separately)."}

aligned_sneak_attack.name: Aligned Sneak Attack
description: ::ab{title="&L&Aligned Sneak Attack (Su)&FN&" icon=lower ability="When making a sneak attack against a creature that has damage reduction that can be overcome by weapons of a particular alignment (such as DR 5/good), the slayer's attack reduces that damage reduction by an amount equal to the number of sneak attack dice rolled until the end of the slayer's turn."}

deadly_range.name: Deadly Range
description: ::ab{title="&L&Deadly Range (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost passive="A slayer with this talent increases the range at which he can deal sneak attack damage by 10 feet." special="A slayer can select this talent more than once; its effects stack." prereq="4th-level slayer"}

blood_reader.name: Blood Reader
description: ::ab{title="&L&Blood Reader (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="While able to see a *studied target,* a slayer with this talent knows exactly how many hit points his opponent has remaining. This only works against living targets."}

eternal_opposition.name: Eternal Opposition
description: ::ab{title="&L&Eternal Opposition (Ex)&FN&" icon=def prereq="‹race/Samsaran›" passive="While most imperial dragons, undead, and other long-enduring foes can count on outlasting their mortal adversaries, the samsaran slayer has pledged to oppose their machinations across all his lifetimes. When his *studied target* is of the dragon, fey, outsider, or undead type, the slayer gains a +2 insight bonus to his AC against its attacks and on saving throws against its abilities."}

jaguars_grace.name: Jaguar's Grace
description: ::ab{title="&L&Jaguar's Grace (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost passive="A slayer with this talent does not take the normal -4 penalty when dealing nonlethal damage using a weapon that normally deals lethal damage. Attacks made this way can apply nonlethal sneak attack damage." prereq="4th-level slayer"}

jaguars_pounce.name: Jaguar's Pounce
description: ::ab{title="&L&Jaguar's Pounce (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee immediate="When a slayer with this talent deals sneak attack damage, he can attempt a ‹rule/disarm› or ‹rule/trip› combat maneuver as if the target were ‹rule/flat-footed› (losing its Dexterity bonus to CMD). This combat maneuver does not provoke attacks of opportunity." prereq="‹slayertalent/Jaguar's grace›"}

jaguars_protection.name: Jaguar's Protection
description: ::ab{title="&L&Jaguar's Protection (Ex)&FN&" icon=protect ability="When a slayer with this talent deals sneak attack damage, he draws the target's attention away from his allies. The affected enemy takes a -2 penalty on attack rolls made against anyone other than the slayer for 1 minute." prereq="‹slayertalent/Jaguar's pounce›"}

mountainside_ambush.name: Mountainside Ambush
description: ::ab{title="&L&Mountainside Ambush (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost prereq="‹race/Samsaran›" flavor="Fighting in the mountains of Zi Ha has trained samsaran slayers to strike the unwary with deadly attacks from above." ability="If a slayer deals sneak attack damage to a creature that is unaware of his presence while he is standing on higher ground than his target, he does not have to roll sneak attack damage; instead, the sneak attack deals maximum damage. The samsaran must be standing on solid ground to use this ability."}

studied_ally.name: Studied Ally
description: ::ab{title="&L&Studied Ally (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost-protect move="The slayer can study an ally or friendly creature he can see. The slayer gains a +1 bonus on checks and attack rolls to use the ‹rule/aid another<_2› action to help with that ally's skill checks, attacks, or AC. This bonus increases at the same rate as a slayer's *studied target* bonus." imp7="A slayer can study an ally as a move or @HLswift_action." special="A slayer's *studied ally* counts against the number of *studied targets* he can have active at once."}

castling.name: Castling
description: ::ab{title="&L&Castling (Ex)&FN&" icon=def passive="The slayer treats soft cover granted by creatures of her size or larger as though it were ‹rule/cover› instead. Cover the slayer gains from this talent does not allow her to attempt Stealth checks."}

catfolk_rogue_talent.name: Catfolk Rogue Talent
description: ::ab{title="&L&Catfolk Rogue Talent&FN&" icon=power prereq="‹race/Catfolk›" ability="A catfolk slayer can select one of the following catfolk ‹ability/rogue talents› in place of a slayer talent: ‹talent/deadly scratch›, ‹talent/graceful faller›, ‹talent/nimble climber›, or ‹talent/vicious claws›. Any talent effects based on rogue level use the slayer's class level. The slayer must fulfill any prerequisites."}

experience_across_ages.name: Experience Across Ages
description: ::ab{title="&L&Experience Across Ages (Ex)&FN&" icon=power prereq="‹race/Samsaran›" useInc=slayer~5~+ useF="1~1~5~1~5" flavor="A samsaran slayer can draw upon insights from his previous lifetimes to help identify a foe or recall a key piece of information." swift="The slayer can attempt a ‹skill/Knowledge› check as if he had a number of ranks in the appropriate Knowledge skill equal to his slayer level."}

extra_earthcraft.name: Extra Earthcraft
description: ::ab{title="&L&Extra Earthcraft&FN&" icon=boost ability="The slayer gains 2 additional earthcraft points each day." prereq="‹arc-rogue/Earth«craft<shadow› ability"}

foil_scrutiny.name: Foil Scrutiny
description: ::ab{title="&L&Foil Scrutiny&FN&" icon=boost-def passive="A slayer with this talent is able to obscure his thoughts and intentions. He gains a +2 bonus on all Bluff and Disguise checks, as well as on Will saving throws to resist mind-reading spells and effects (such as ‹spell/detect thoughts› and ‹spell/discern lies›)."}

fortified_position.name: Fortified Position
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fortified Position (Ex)&FN&" icon=def passive="Whenever the slayer gains a bonus on Reflex saves due to cover, she gains an equal bonus on Fortitude saves."}

graceful_athlete.name: Graceful Athlete
description: ::ab{title="&L&Graceful Athlete&FN&" icon=power ability="Gain ‹feat/Graceful Athlete› as a bonus feat. You must meet the prerequisites for the feat."}

inured_to_terror.name: Inured to Terror
description: ::ab{title="&L&Inured to Terror (Ex)&FN&" icon=def prereq="‹race/Samsaran›" flavor="With their knowledge of the cyclical nature of existence, there are few experiences that can daunt samsaran slayers for long." immediate="When a slayer fails a saving throw against a fear effect, he can attempt the saving throw a second time to reduce the severity of the effect from ‹misc/panicked› to ‹misc/frightened›, frightened to ‹misc/shaken›, or shaken to unaffected. Additionally, the DC of Intimidate checks to demoralize him increases by 2."}

mystic_veil.name: Mystic Veil
description: ::ab{title="&L&Mystic Veil (Sp)&FN&" icon=magic prereq="‹race/Samsaran›, Intelligence 11+" flavor="Samsaran slayers are adept at obscuring the passes of their mountain homes from intruders." useInc=slayer~2 useF="2~1" ability="The slayer can cast ‹spell/silent image› as a spell-like ability, using his slayer level as his caster level. The slayer uses his Intelligence modifier on ‹rule/concentration› checks when using this ability, and the DC to disbelieve the illusion is equal to 11 + the slayer's Intelligence modifier."}

one_of_those_faces.name: One of Those Faces
description: ::ab{title="&L&One of Those Faces (Sp)&FN&" icon=magic ability="Each day, you can use ‹spell/disguise self› as a spell-like ability for up to 10 minutes per character level. This duration need not be continuous, but it must be used in 10-minute increments." special="Once you have used this ability, whenever you use it for the next 24 hours you must take the same alternate appearance."}

poison_use.name: Poison Use
description: ::ab{title="&L&Poison Use (Ex)&FN&" icon=def ability="The slayer is trained in the use of poison, and can't accidentally poison herself when applying poison to a weapon."}

toxin_training.name: Toxin Training
description: ::ab{title="&L&Toxin Training (Ex)&FN&" icon=def passive="The slayer builds resistance to certain poisons over time. Each time he chooses this talent, he chooses one ability score. He gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against poisons that deal damage to the chosen ability score." special="The slayer can choose this talent multiple times. Each time he does, he chooses a new ability score and gains the bonus on saves against poisons that target that ability." prereq="4th-level slayer, ‹slayertalent/poison use›"}

focused_poison.name: Focused Poison
description: ::ab{title="&L&Focused Poison (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost flavor="The slayer can focus his poison delivery to be especially deadly to his *studied target.*" ability="When the slayer studies a target, he can immediately reduce the number of additional *studied targets* he can maintain. Reducing this number does not require an action. For each target reduced in this way, the DC of poisons used against his *studied target* increases by 1." prereq="6th-level slayer, ‹slayertalent/poison use›"}

ranger_combat_style.name: Ranger Combat Style
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ranger Combat Style (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The slayer selects a ranger ‹ability/combat style<s› (such as archery or two-weapon combat) and gains a combat feat from the first feat list of that style. He can choose feats from his selected combat style, even if he does not have the normal prerequisites." imp6="He may select this talent again and add the 6th-level ranger combat feats from his chosen style to the list." imp10="He may select this talent again and add the 10th-level ranger combat feats from his chosen style to the list."}

recall_training.name: Recall Training
description: ::ab{title="&L&Recall Training (Ex)&FN&" icon=power prereq="‹race/Samsaran›" flavor="By calling on the memories of previous incarnations, a samsaran slayer can use martial techniques that transcend his usual capabilities." move="Once per day, the slayer can gain the benefit of a ‹main/combat feat› he doesn't have. This effect lasts for 1 minute per slayer level he has. The slayer must meet all the feat's prerequisites."}

redirect_poison.name: Redirect Poison
description: ::ab{title="&L&Redirect Poison (Ex)&FN&" icon=def-melee flavor="The slayer can divert poisoned attacks against him." immediate="When a creature unsuccessfully attacks the slayer with a poisoned weapon or a natural weapon that would poison him, the slayer can attempt to redirect the attack to a creature within his reach (including, possibly, the creature that unsuccessfully attacked the slayer). The slayer can make an attack roll against the creature to which he would redirect the poison. On a success, the poison is redirected to the target, and the target must attempt a saving throw against the poison as normal." special="This attack only redirects the poison and does not otherwise damage the targeted creature. This ability cannot affect a creature that attacked the slayer with a poisoned natural weapon, but it can affect a creature that attacked him with a poisoned manufactured weapon."}

rogue_talent.name: Rogue Talent
description: ::ab{title="&L&Rogue Talent&FN&" icon=power ability="A slayer can select one of the following ‹ability/rogue talents› in place of a slayer talent: ‹talent/bleeding attack›&#42&, ‹talent/camouflage›, ‹talent/cloying shades›, ‹talent/combat trick›, ‹talent/demand attention›, ‹talent/emboldening strike›, ‹talent/extinguishing strike›, ‹talent/fast stealth›, ‹talent/feint from shadows›, ‹talent/finesse rogue›, ‹talent/firearm training›, ‹talent/focusing attack›, ‹talent/gloom magic›, ‹talent/greater gloom magic›, ‹talent/grit›, ‹talent/hard to fool›, ‹talent/lasting poison›, ‹talent/mien of despair›, ‹talent/obscuring blow›, ‹talent/poison use›, ‹talent/powerful sneak›, ‹talent/rogue crawl›, ‹talent/shadow duplicate›, ‹talent/shadow's chill›, ‹talent/slow reactions›&#42&, ‹talent/snap shot›, ‹talent/sniper's eye›, ‹talent/surprise attack›, ‹talent/swift poison›, ‹talent/terrain mastery›, ‹talent/trap spotter›, ‹talent/umbral gear›, ‹talent/underhanded trick›, ‹talent/unwitting ally›, or ‹talent/weapon training›.~~~Any talent effects based on rogue level use the slayer's class level. If the rogue talent has a prerequisite, the slayer must meet the prerequisite before taking that rogue talent.~~~If the talent is marked with an asterisk (&#42&), the talent is considered a Primary Sneak Attack Talent (only one Primary Sneak Attack Talent can be applied to an individual attack, and the decision must be made before the attack roll is made)." special="This talent can be selected multiple times; each time, it grants the slayer a new rogue talent."}

scrying_familiarity.name: Scrying Familiarity
description: ::ab{title="&L&Scrying Familiarity (Ex)&FN&" icon=def-boost-roll flavor="You are well acquainted with scrying sensors." passive="You can roll twice and take the better result on saving throws against divination (scrying) spells and effects, on Perception checks to notice scrying sensors, and on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance when you use a scrying spell or effect." ability="If you notice a magical sensor, you can attempt a Stealth check opposed by the caster's caster level check to avoid being detected by the sensor." order=pa}

sticks_and_stones.name: Sticks and Stones
description: ::ab{title="&L&Sticks and Stones (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The slayer gains ‹feat/Catch Off-Guard› as a bonus feat."}

sunlight_strike.name: Sunlight Strike
description: ::ab{title="&L&Sunlight Strike (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower swift="The slayer can reflect sunlight (or other sources of bright light) into the eyes of an adjacent target, causing it to gain the ‹misc/dazzled› condition for 1 round."}

sure_footing.name: Sure Footing
description: ::ab{title="&L&Sure Footing (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost passive="The slayer gains a +5 bonus on Acrobatics checks to move on narrow surfaces and loose or uneven ground."}

trapfinding.name: Trapfinding
description: ::ab{title="&L&Trapfinding&FN&" icon=skill-power info="The slayer gains ‹skill/Disable Device› as a class skill." order=na ability="The slayer also gains the ‹ability/trapfinding› and ‹ability/trap sense› ‹class/rogue› abilities, using his slayer level as his effective rogue level."}

unbalancing_trick.name: Unbalancing Trick
description: ::ab{title="&L&Unbalancing Trick (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The slayer gains ‹feat/Improved Trip› as a bonus feat, even if she does not meet the prerequisites." imp6="She is treated as if she meets all the prerequisites of ‹feat/Greater Trip› (although she must take the feat as normal to gain its benefits)."}

armored_marauder.name: Armored Marauder
description: ::ab{title="&L&Armored Marauder (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-boost flavor="Some elite slayers exchange leather and chain for plate when stalking prey." ability="A slayer with this talent gains proficiency with heavy armor. In addition, the armor check penalty of any heavy armor the slayer wears is reduced by 1 for every 6 class levels he has."}

armored_swiftness.name: Armored Swiftness
description: ::ab{title="&L&Armored Swiftness (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost flavor="In time, the heaviest armor can become like a second skin." ability="A slayer with this talent can move at full speed in heavy armor. In addition, the maximum Dexterity bonus of heavy armor the slayer wears increases by 1 for every 6 class levels he has." prereq="‹slayertalent/Armored marauder›"}

assassinate.name: Assassinate
description: ::ab{title="&L&Assassinate (Ex)&FN&" icon=power flavor="A slayer with this advanced talent can kill foes that are unable to defend themselves." ability="To attempt to assassinate a target, the slayer must first study his target for 1 round as a @HLstandard_action. On the following round, if the slayer makes a sneak attack against the target and that target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC, the sneak attack has the additional effect of possibly killing the target. This attempt automatically fails if the target recognizes the slayer as an enemy.~~~If the sneak attack is successful, the target must attempt a Fortitude saving throw with a DC equal to 10 + 1/2 the slayer's level + the slayer's Intelligence modifier. If the target fails this save, it dies; otherwise, the target takes the sneak attack damage as normal and is then immune to that slayer's *assassinate* ability for 24 hours."}

marksmans_shot.name: Marksman's Shot
description: ::ab{title="&L&Marksman's Shot (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost flavor="Those who seek to slay with a single shot must have keen eyes and perfect poise." ability="As an attack action, the slayer makes a single ranged attack at his highest attack bonus with a ranged weapon he wields. The target of the attack must be the slayer's *studied target.* On a successful hit, the slayer doubles the number of sneak attack dice applied to the attack; if the attack was not a sneak attack, this benefit does not apply."}

reaping_stalker.name: Reaping Stalker
description: ::ab{title="&L&Reaping Stalker (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost flavor="Some slayers prefer weapons with grim symbolism of lives cut short and can wield such weapons with unparalleled lethality." passive="A slayer with this talent treats any ‹eq-weapon/sickle› or ‹eq-weapon/scythe› he wields as though it were ‹misc/one size category larger› for the purpose of determining its damage dice. In addition, the slayer increases the critical threat range of any sickle or scythe he wields by 1; this does not stack with other effects that alter a weapon's threat range."}

rogue_and_ninja_advanced_talents.name: Rogue and Ninja Advanced Talents
description: :::ab{title="&L&Rogue and Ninja Advanced Talents&FN&" icon=power action=Ability special="A slayer can select multiple rogue advanced talents or ninja master tricks by taking this slayer advanced talent multiple times, but can't select the same one more than once."}
A slayer can select one of the following rogue *advanced talents* or ninja *master tricks* in place of a slayer advanced talent.

@HL[Advanced rogue talents:] ‹talent/aligned disguise›, ‹talent/blinding strike›, ‹talent/dance of disorienting shadows›, ‹talent/deadly sneak›, ‹talent/feat›, ‹talent/hunter's surprise›, ‹talent/improved shadow's chill›, ‹talent/knock-out blow›, ‹talent/master of disguise›, ‹talent/opportunist›, ‹talent/reflexive shadow shield›, ‹talent/see in darkness›, ‹talent/stealthy sniper›.
@HL[Master Tricks:] ‹ninjatrick/evasion›, ‹ninjatrick/feat›.

slayer_camouflage.name: Slayer Camouflage
description: ::ab{title="&L&Slayer Camouflage (Ex)&FN&" icon=def ability="A slayer can use the Stealth skill to hide in any of his ‹ability/favored terrain«s›, even if the terrain doesn't grant cover or concealment." prereq="‹talent/Terrain mastery› (rogue talent)"}

swallow_reversal.name: Swallow Reversal
description: ::ab{title="&L&Swallow Reversal (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee-roll flavor="This technique, a creation of a legendary Minkaian duelist, mimics the movement of a bird in flight to pierce an opponent's defenses." ability="As an attack action, the slayer can make a single melee attack against his *studied target* at his highest base attack bonus. When attempting a *swallow reversal,* the slayer rolls two attack rolls and uses the highest result. If the attack is a critical threat, the slayer attempts to confirm the critical hit as normal." special="The slayer can use *swallow reversal* at will, but it can only be used against a given target once per day."}

woodland_stride.name: Woodland Stride
description: ::ab{title="&L&Woodland Stride (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="A slayer with this talent may move through any sort of undergrowth (such as natural thorns, briars, overgrown areas, and similar terrain) at his normal speed and without taking damage or suffering any other impairment. Terrain that is enchanted or magically manipulated to impede motion still affects the slayer as normal."}
